outcome: Sodium ion level difference between an arterial blood gas analyzer and an autoanalyzer
cohort: The cohort consisted of 106 very-low-birth-weight infants admitted to Jeonbuk National Hospital Neonatal Intensive Care Units between October 2013 and December 2016.
finding: Protein at birth and percent of maximum weight loss were significantly associated with a sodium level difference exceeding 4 mmol/L between blood gas analyzer and biochemistry autoanalyzer in very-low-birth-weight infants.
followup_time: Clinical factors observed within a week of birth; blood samples collected within an hour after birth.
